args.description: Pixel Heaven RPG MONSTER SPRITE, native crisp 1px pixel art on a TRANSPARENT 68x68 canvas. Match small existing 32x48 RPG hero sprites. Slightly overhead three-quarter RPG camera, NOT flat side-view cartoon. Upper-left light, rich but restrained volumetric shading and selective dark outline. One low rounded sage-green gelatinous slime with two tiny dark eyes at its LEFT-facing front, a blue-grey lower shaded rim and warm pale upper-left highlight. A plump asymmetric jelly mound with dimensional translucency, no arms or legs. The VISIBLE slime is only 32 pixels wide by 24 pixels tall: entirely x18..49 y34..57. It rests on y57, left-facing west. IMPORTANT transparent margins are intentional: do NOT expand the body to fill the canvas. Fixed virtual ground pivot(34,58). Only one monster. No scene, ground/platform, floor, shadow blob, checkerboard, UI, text or effects. Limited 8-16 colors drawn from: #2E342F #454C43 #E9DDC6 #CBBDA2 #BAC4C1 #7B9299 #4D626B #7F9B86 #526F61 #65899A #B46F55 #784C40 #D6A078 #9285A7 #665D7A #DEC58B #AF9254 #896849 #5D4D3B #9A9B88 #676F63 #D1A382 #9A6E52 #4C433E.
